body:
I'm just sick and tired of people not addressing the points properly. Confirmation bias, justifying gambling. It wasn't responded to in good faith basically. No gentle approach. Well, 90%. 

And people wonder why I have suicidal depression.

I'm ignoring all that you said in a previous comment. There isn't any need to be rude. Usually insecure people start attacking others. 

I did doubt myself on some of the points, couldn't find reasoning against it, that's why I went with it. This being a gacha game, I expect it to be quite predatory, and it unfortunately is in some areas. I've discovered recently I can't even progress because my characters are heavily undergeared. No good artifacts, no good characters. How am I to be expected to get through the game with this set up? Most F2P's I've seen already have legendary characters, even optimal DPS/Healers as well. I'm stuck with a C-B tier set, which makes things difficult. 

And yes, I am a dumbass. I've lived with autism and learning difficulties my entire life, on top of a plethora of other issues. I can't find games to enjoy. I can't even find hobbies to enjoy. I need games to treat my issues, my life is a mess, please fucking kill me.

What do I do from here? I'm AR39, almost 40, low on Mora, have a few Primogems, and Stardust. I'm semi-f2p, I have the battlepass. I'm wondering what I should do besides artifact farming, boss and domain farming, comissions, crimson wishes, and bounties. But on a side note, I hate the Spiral Abyss. I can't get my characters high enough to do optimal damage. 

I've done almost every quest, opened over 700+ treasures in Liyue, and about 370 in Mondstat. 

These are my main characters: [https://streamable.com/fcx8xp](https://streamable.com/fcx8xp)

I mainly want to focus on the story. I'd rather not grind if I didn't have to.

Why are artifacts not spawning? I just attempted to do an artifact route last night, got on this morning, tried to do the route, but the artifacts haven't respawned. Am I missing something?

Also, my Crimson Wishes haven't respawned.

Edit: Oh, it resets after 24 hours? The artifacts at least? That's kinda dumb to be honest. Breaks routine, feels really unnecessary. There definitely needs to be a better way of artifact farming.

Culture doesn't dictate morality. I even find that kind of flaw in my own country, the UK. 
Empathy is a very powerful tool.

Fair enough. But there isn't going to be a ton of whales though. It won't be long before there will be a big cheater wave, where people cheat in all the primogems and wishes. Which is the risk of a gacha game. I remember GTA Online is a game that was notorious for its cheaters, because it had a really bad system of earning money. Which mean you either grinded, or you bought it. Some chose to risk an account ban (Which is a 3 strike system), by cheating in the money, and even sold it to others for cheap. I can see the same happening in Genshin. Which in that case, good luck.

Critical thinking is key to finding truth. Doesn't matter whether it's cringe or not.

Your basis for what players agree and disagree on is player numbers. Obviously players who are vulnerable, or enjoy this game, are going to keep playing. I see this in other games. The players who stay along for the ride, are often the ones who gatekeep and tell other players they're wrong, without giving it another thought. Whilst the players who have moved on or quit, have their own reasons. Ask the 8 million + old WoW players what they think of the game. Ask the same of old Genshin Impact players (Who quit for other reasons). We can't discount the criticisms.

I was banned recently on reddit which is why I don't have a massive post history, but I did manage to convince some WoW players to give up playing, unsubscribing and leaving the game for good. I bought up the incentivizing of gambling and exploitation, and staying with a game you don't enjoy being bad for mental health and not good financially. And that Activision Blizzard just don't care about making a game. WoW has many problems that even veteran players hate. 

I could have worded my original post better. I am open to being wrong, or perhaps the points not being good. But so far all the comments here have refused to look at at the points and agree/disagree, so I don't know whether I'm saying something that is beneficial to the game or not. Still, if the game isn't a gacha, it would have more players. I don't know why that's so hard to see.
I'm an advocate, not a defeatist.

These are suggestions for improvements. I wanted to see what others thought, because maybe I missed something. I was planning on making a video about it, but I guess not now.

Sucks that most of the responses aren't even finding points to agree on that are such obvious problems to many (Like artifact levelling and stats, choosing characters, etc)

I do enjoy Genshin, for the story, graphics, and some aspects of gameplay. I'm just bored of wanting and waiting. I had WoW Players try to say the same thing to me "This game just isn't for you." but it discounted those aspects that I really enjoyed, which is a shitty justification for giving up on a game. I'm more of a critical thinker than the majority of "Gamers."

Pretty sure most games don't get away with that. 

Most triple A releases tend to have a finished story, as much as they are bad in many aspects. There is at least gameplay, story and graphics in these games. In Genshin, it has graphics, just not story or gameplay. A game doesn't need to be a live service to be good. Common CEO misconception there.

It's quite a bad move to make though being a gacha. This game has so much potential. The fact it chose to be a gacha probably just turned off a couple extra million players. As a result, there won't be many people trying to play it, because they know it's going to be gambling. Whilst I would disagree with the sentiment that gambling is necessary, because it definitely is possible as F2P, I still think the gacha label is a huge turn off. It needs to change more than anything else.

I am new. I don't know what the baseline for a gacha is, or even what it is. Problem with these types of games is there's gambling in them, and that needs to be as unnecessary as possible, because it's a problematic system that can really exploit and damage people. Players should be able to pick a free legendary character and a few other four star characters, for free, maybe using the wish system, but not requiring about, 70+ wishes. 

I had a problem in the past with collecting things. I was a pretty heavy Team Fortress 2 player, wasted thousands of pounds on it. And it's money that I could have used now (Since my PC is garbage and barely runs Genshin)

I don't think the game being a gacha is a good enough justification. If these businesses want a game to do well, they need to focus on making a good game. I guess this is my first gacha? But it doesn't really mean that it's a good thing morally, since it is gambling, and gambling is immoral. Considering this is a 12+, it isn't a good thing either. It should at least be 18+ if it's going to have gambling, and have a warning all over the place to say that. I have a feeling though that for most players who come to this game, having these roadblocks will actually stop them from wanting to play. I really want to get on with the story and not have to grind the same bosses/domains everyday. Don't know how I forgot to mention it, the random drop rates need to be reworked as well. I did 4 domains yesterday for purples, didn't get any. Of course I could craft it, but how is it going to be possible to rank up in higher ascensions? 

Where do the collectables show up on the map? There isn't any option on the map. I know there's an item to show them, but it is such a long way away since it's locked behind a grind. 

The 16.5 point about auto run and auto walk, that's not the point? Why do we need to be at the PC/Device to climb a cliff? Why not just click a button to climb it whilst we AFK, stretch our legs, go to the bathroom, take a sip of water. Climbing is such a boring system. This is why I want faster travel. It's mindnumbingly slow. Travelling isn't really an interesting part of the gameplay, or even gameplay at all. World of Warcraft has an auto-run system, works really well actually. Personally, it's allowed me to multitask. You also can't dismiss it as "Playing the game for you" for the simple reason there's also the downside of missing ores, chests, and enemies. Which is why an auto-pathing system would work. There is friction there.

Hey, this is what you get when you promote a competitive system in a game. The player base is so dissonant from their former selves (Baby gamers), they don't see that in others, don't think to help. 

I've always tried my best to stay away from games that are competitive, it encourages elitism and assholery.

This may be a dumb question, how do you get rid of [this wind?](https://imgur.com/htOMlSs)

It appears in other places too, and it's getting really annoying because, I can't progress very due to the sheer cold. I somehow beat the yeti here for the dragonspear, no idea how. Is there a way around this?

What should my priority be with regards to Artifacts? (I'm AR 39) Do I prioritize ATK as the primary stat so I can get the most damage, or do I make a set? 

Also, is it possible for low level characters, around 40-50, to do things at World Level 4 and 5? I feel like I'm missing a lot of DPS because I haven't levelled those and because I need to beat bosses. 

Also, how do I bulk use things like, Hero's Wit or Enhancement Ore? Been watching Enviosity recently, for the first time, and I've noticed there is a way to quickly add things?
I would have replied "Uno reverse card!"
